import FreeCAD

# Open the precondition file
doc = FreeCAD.open("/home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd")

# Check for CAM workbench objects
print("Checking SetupSheet object:")
setup_sheet = doc.getObject("SetupSheet")
if setup_sheet:
    print(f"  TypeId: {setup_sheet.TypeId}")
    print(f"  Label: {setup_sheet.Label}")
    
    # Check properties
    if hasattr(setup_sheet, 'Properties'):
        for prop in setup_sheet.Properties:
            print(f"    Property: {prop}")

# Check Operations group
print("\nOperations group contents:")
ops_group = doc.getObject("Operations")
if ops_group:
    print(f"  Objects in group: {[obj.Name for obj in ops_group.Group]}")

# Check Model group
print("\nModel group contents:")
model_group = doc.getObject("Model")
if model_group:
    print(f"  Objects in group: {[obj.Name for obj in model_group.Group]}")

# Check Tools group
print("\nTools group contents:")
tools_group = doc.getObject("Tools")
if tools_group:
    print(f"  Objects in group: {[obj.Name for obj in tools_group.Group]}")

# Check Stock object
print("\nStock object:")
stock = doc.getObject("Stock")
if stock:
    print(f"  TypeId: {stock.TypeId}")
    print(f"  Label: {stock.Label}")
    for prop in stock.Properties:
        print(f"    {prop}: {getattr(stock, prop, 'N/A')}")

FreeCAD.closeDocument(doc.Name)
EOF"}
